## Anacite Laborer (CR 7)

**XP** 3,200  
LN Medium construct  
**Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +9  


**Defense**


**AC** 20, touch 14, flat-footed 16 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +6 natural)  
**hp** 78 (9d10+29)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +6, **Will** +3  
**Immune** construct traits  
**Weaknesses** sunlight dependency  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** plasma cutter +13 (4d8 fire)  
**Ranged** electrical burst +13 (4d6 electricity)  


**Tactics**


**During Combat** The anacite laborer is equally at home attacking with its plasma cutter and its electrical burst.  

**Morale** If reduced to fewer than 8 hit points, the anacite laborer flees.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 16, **Dex** 17, Con—, **Int** 11, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +12; **CMD** 26  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Skill Focus (Knowledge [engineering]), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Weapon Focus (electrical burst, plasma cutter)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Knowledge (engineering) +15, Perception +9  
**Languages** Common; shortwave (100 ft.)  
**SQ** laborer protocol, reconfigure  


**Special Abilities**


**Electrical Burst (Ex)** An anacite laborer’s electrical burst has a range increment of 30 feet.  

**Laborer Protocol (Ex)** Knowledge (engineering) is a class skill for an anacite laborer.  

**Reconfigure (Ex)** An anacite laborer is capable of adapting and improving its designs. The anacite has a number of built-in abilities equal to its CR divided by 3 (minimum 1), chosen from the list below. An anacite laborer can change these abilities by spending 1 uninterrupted hour for each ability it wants to change. The anacite must also have access to an appropriate workspace for the duration. An ability can be gained only once unless stated otherwise. In addition, modifications other than those listed here might exist.
